import os
progdir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u006/system/state/workspace/programs')
progdir.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            comp = []
            while q:
                x, y = q.popleft()
                comp.append((x, y))
                for nx, ny in ((x-1,y),(x+1,y),(x,y-1),(x,y+1)):
                    if 0 <= nx < h and 0 <= ny < w and grid[nx][ny] == 0 and (nx,ny) not in seen:
                        seen.add((nx,ny))
                        q.append((nx,ny))
            comps.append(comp)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    small = min(comps, key=len)
    large = max(comps, key=len)
    for r, c in small:
        out[r][c] = 7
    large_set = set(large)
    endpoints = []
    for r, c in large:
        degree = sum((nr, nc) in large_set for nr, nc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)))
        if degree == 1:
            endpoints.append((r,c))
    # Keep the upper exposed tip unfilled when the largest region has a one-cell spur.
    top = min(r for r, c in large)
    omit = [p for p in endpoints if p[0] == top]
    for r, c in large:
        if (r,c) not in omit:
            out[r][c] = 8
    return out
'''
